chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from Aban, from Yahya al-Azraq, the seller of Sabiri cloth, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام, and I said:
A man performed the Jumu'ah prayer and recited
"Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High" and "Say: He is Allah, One."
He عليه السلام said: “It sufficed him.”

key_terms.أَجْزَأَهُ: it was sufficient and fulfilled the required recitation
key_terms.اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Allah is One, referring to Surat al-Ikhlas and affirming tawhid
key_terms.سَبِّحِ: the opening word referring to Surat al-A'la
key_terms.فَقَرَأَ: then he recited during the prayer

ai.seo_question: Is it sufficient to recite Surat al-A'la and Surat al-Ikhlas in the Jumu'ah prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about recitation in the Jumu'ah prayer. It indicates that if a person recites Surat al-A'la and Surat al-Ikhlas in Jumu'ah, that recitation is sufficient.
